nodes.speaker: The Cartographer
nodes.text: The lantern's gone dark, and half my map with it. You're not from here, are you? Good. Maybe you'll notice what we stopped seeing.

nodes.speaker: The Cartographer
nodes.text: Three places lost their names when the light went out. Bring back what you find, and I'll help you write them down again.

nodes.speaker: The Cartographer
nodes.text: The rain garden's closest, past the gate. Something's still growing there, which is more than I can say for the rest of us.
